title: Photograph 3
reviewAlt: A dark stone rests in the dry interior of a shallow stone basin, below and clearly inside the rim.
audioScript: A. The round basin is full of water. B. A bird is standing on the edge. C. A stone has been placed inside the basin. D. The stone is balanced on the rim.
